mappingPolicy: Only topologically determined mappings (counter boundary <-> counter contour) are 'mapped'. Positive-mass components are 'provisional-unmapped': candidateRefs are reviewable proposals with a stated geometric basis, not facts. Source path order is not evidence of stroke order.

components.name: left-leg
components.basis: Leftmost vertical edge x=8 (y 132->42), inner edge x=34 below the crossbar, and the foot at y=132.

components.name: right-leg
components.basis: Rightmost vertical edge x=96, foot at y=132, inner edge x=70 below the crossbar.

components.name: apex-zone
components.basis: Two diagonal shoulders and the flat top above y=42. Leg/apex boundary at the y=42 nodes is an interpretation.

components.name: crossbar-zone
components.basis: Underside y=91 (x 70->34) and the counter's closing bottom edge y=66. Whether the crossbar is an independent bar or an integrated contour transition is undecided (spec §4 A).

components.name: counter-boundary
components.basis: Topologically determined: the only inner contour.

components.name: spine
components.basis: Left edge x=10 (closing segment) and the counters' left edges at x=35.

components.name: upper-bowl
components.basis: Top edge y=8 and the two quadratics down to the waist node (77,69). The top edge is shared with the spine region.

components.name: lower-bowl
components.basis: Quadratics from the waist node down to y=132 and the bottom edge, shared with the spine region.

components.name: waist-junction
components.basis: Concave outer node (77,69) between the bowls; its extent is not a segment.

components.name: counter-upper
components.basis: Topologically determined: upper inner contour by measured position.

components.name: counter-lower
components.basis: Topologically determined: lower inner contour by measured position.

components.name: outer-bowl
components.basis: Outer left/top/bottom edges and the inner left wall x=29 with its chamfers.

components.name: upper-terminal
components.basis: Upper right edges ending in the closing end cap (80,43)->(94,25).

components.name: lower-terminal
components.basis: Lower right edges up to the bar top (98,76). In this contour the lower bowl end merges into the bar attachment; the boundary between them is undetermined.

components.name: internal-bar
components.basis: Bar top y=76 (x 98->59), inner end x=59, underside y=96.

components.name: bar-attachment
components.basis: Spur x=73 (y 96->108) and inner bottom edge y=108 joining bar and bowl.

components.name: aperture-boundary
components.basis: Not mapped: the aperture is not yet classified (AUD-01). No boundary is synthesised.

apertureInterpretation.intendedIdentity: Exterior-connected opening that distinguishes G from C and O (identity profile: apertureCount 1).
observations: Single closed outer contour; legacy hole array is empty.

Observed (unreviewed): the unfilled interior bounded by the inner wall (outer#15), inner top (outer#16/#17) and the bar (outer#09) meets the outside on the right, between the upper terminal end cap (outer#19) and the bar top edge (outer#09).
blockers: Exterior connectivity not yet proven by planar topology analysis (T04).
aperture-boundary component has no reviewed geometry mapping.
Measurement construction for apertureWidth is undefined (AUD-03).
